examples.quote: Tighten the fixture's objective stopping tolerance because the original BFGS settings stop before the existing gradient criterion is met. R's installed `?optim` documentation confirms that `reltol` controls relative objective reduction. At `1e-12`, the objective agrees with the selected `1e-10` run within 4.03e-10. The tighter fit changes the unit-slope covariance by about 0.573% relative to the early-stopped fit and passes the existing truth-recovery assertions.
